clips.title: The story
paras: Murloc Heads are grim trophies severed from the amphibious creatures prowling the Western Strand in Hillsbrad Foothills. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle of Southshore requires them as physical proof of culled threats to satisfy his superior, Marshal Redpath.

Southshore faces dangers from all directions, but the aggressive murlocs clustering along the Western Strand are an immediate menace to local fishermen and coastal travelers. Although Alliance adventurers frequently sweep the beaches to cull the creatures, Marshal Marcus Redpath demands undeniable verification before signing off on defensive reports. To humor the bureaucracy, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle relies on hired fighters to haul in cold, dripping murloc heads—an unpleasant task Farren himself finds entirely repulsive, especially given how thoroughly the sight has spoiled his appetite for Southshore's local seafood.
